text: Owner clarified the governing policy directly on 2026-08-31; public decision post-01M1CN0CHHMYSA93R7AZMPZQB2. Only the actual Sherlock episode video file content is barred from Git/storage/redistribution. Annotations, recall transcripts/exports, transformations and receipts, graphs, features, reports, model outputs, and all other derived Sherlock data may be stored and shared. This supersedes the earlier broad local-only interpretation and removes new licence/consent/REB holds for those artifacts. Scientific identity, provenance, timebase/transformation, coordinate separation, admission, uncertainty, and anti-circularity courts remain. Successor must update the intake court plus conflicting ADR/movie-plan policy text, while keeping raw video bytes excluded and making no legal-adjudication claim.
